abstract: One hundred sixty-two gestational trophoblastic tumors (GTT) were treated at the Institute Gustave-Roussy, Villejuif, France, from 1975 to 1985. Sustained complete remission (CR) was obtained in 146 patients (90%). All 97 patients with no histologic diagnosis of choriocarcinoma were cured, including 19 patients considered at high risk initially. Among 65 histologic chariocarcinoma patients, 16 died (CR, 75.5%) including seven initially nonmetastatic patients. Using a univariate analysis, all factors tested in the whole group of patients were more or less significant except for age and parity. However, when the same variables were tested in patients considered at high risk initially, only three factors were statistically significant. Those three factors were the only ones associated with a statistically significant higher relative death risk (RR) on multivariate analysis and are as follows: an antecedent nonmolar pregnancy (RR = 4.3; P less than 0.01); initial presentation with more than one metastatic organ (RR = 7.4; P less than 0.01); and primary resistance to single agent (RR = 18.8; P less than 0.0001) or multi-agent chemotherapy (RR = 26.1; P less than 0.0001). It seems that those three factors, together with a histologic diagnosis of choriocarcinoma, are the prognostic factors that discriminate patients with unfavorable outcomes among the high-risk group.
abstract_ja: 1975年から1985年までにフランスのVillejuifにあるGustave-Roussy研究所で162例の絨毛性腫瘍(GTT)が治療された。162例中146例(90%)で持続的完全寛解(CR)が得られた。組織学的に絨毛癌と診断されなかった97例はすべて治癒し、初期に高リスクと判断された19例も含まれる。組織学的に絨毛癌と診断された65例のうち16例が死亡した(CR 75.5%)。初期に非転移性であった7例も含まれる。単変量解析では、年齢と経産回数を除き、全患者群で検討したすべての因子が多少なりとも有意であった。しかし、初期に高リスクと判断された患者で同じ変数を検討した場合、統計学的に有意であったのは3因子のみであった。その3因子は、多変量解析において統計学的に有意に高い相対死亡リスク(RR)と関連した唯一の因子であり、以下のとおりである:非胞状奇胎妊娠の既往(RR = 4.3; P < 0.01)、初診時に複数の転移臓器を有すること(RR = 7.4; P < 0.01)、単剤化学療法(RR = 18.8; P < 0.0001)または多剤化学療法(RR = 26.1; P < 0.0001)への原発性耐性。これら3因子は、絨毛癌の組織学的診断とともに、高リスク群の中で不良な転帰をたどる患者を識別する予後因子と考えられる。
